verdict.rationale: Sentry ships automations, such as alert rules that send notifications, create tickets or call webhooks, and Seer Autofix triage, so this axis applies. However, the evidence never documents version history, review or approval of changes, or rollback for those automations. API versioning and the deprecation policy cover the web API, not user automations, and Seer Code Review reviews code PRs, not automation changes; both are adjacent features that earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
